dedupe_keys.name: network measurements while uploading 5 6 kb files from moving buses to cellular networks in varmland sweden

description: The MONROE project deposits measurements of 5.6 KB warning-message uploads from moving buses on roads in Värmland, Sweden. The public CC BY 4.0 CSV contains transaction time and status for UDP, TCP and HTTPS over three anonymised mobile operators. Its own page documents GPS position, bus and run identifiers, radio-access technology, signal metrics and availability under 200 ms, 1 s and 6 s deadlines. This joint transport and telecom series could calibrate simulations of vehicle-to-infrastructure warning delivery or test how multi-operator access changes application reliability. Operator labels are anonymised and the traces capture a historical campaign, not current national coverage. The page does not provide a complete network topology or guarantee that bus routes sampled every road condition. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this named Värmland upload dataset. The 13.9 MB CSV was not downloaded, so row counts, missing GPS fields and measured distributions remain unchecked.
name: Network Measurements while Uploading 5.6 KB Files from Moving Buses to Cellular Networks in Varmland, Sweden.
